sets.prompt:
Create ONE wide 2:1 transparent production game UI sprite atlas. Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, EIGHT separate centered square achievement medals, identical cell size. Grid centers at x12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% and y25%,75%. Each entire medal fits within 88% of its cell with transparent gutters, never crosses cell edge. Alpha transparent background, NO grid lines or surrounding titles.
Art direction: highly crafted engraved enamel operation medals, vintage crosshatched print texture, sculpted ivory layered frames, dark navy recessed centers, geometric decorative cutouts, richly colored accent inlays; crisp silhouettes. Same family shape across this set: precision cog-shaped medallions. Palette: cyan, coral and ivory. Distinctive eight individual central emblems IN EXACT ROW-MAJOR ORDER: radio mirror connection, crystalline memory engine, twin signal relays, model cabinet, calibration target, routed cables, safe power switch, constellation of connected cores.
Critical typography: EACH MEDAL MUST HAVE ITS OWN DIFFERENT ENGLISH TITLE on a cream ribbon, bold condensed engraved lettering, correctly spelled, legible, no Chinese. These are EXACT titles IN ROW-MAJOR ORDER, one for each icon: cell 1: "MIRROR LINK"; cell 2: "MEMORY CORE"; cell 3: "DUAL SIGNAL"; cell 4: "SECOND CHANNEL"; cell 5: "CALIBRATED"; cell 6: "RIGHT CONNECTION"; cell 7: "SAFE SWITCH"; cell 8: "STEADY SIGNAL". Do not put the same title on multiple badges. Do not use a shared brand word as filler. Each ribbon should be wide enough to fit its respective title, use two lines if needed. A tiny "OPERATION" above the title is optional. No other text. This is a sprite sheet consumed directly by CSS with square cells, spacing must be exact. Flat orthographic emblem artwork, no scenery, no mockup photograph, no detached shadows.

sets.cleanupPrompt: Edit this existing sprite atlas only to clean the alpha background. Preserve every medal, illustration, color, ALL eight English titles exactly, sizes, positions, the 4-by-2 grid and the 2:1 canvas.
